papers.title: Effectiveness of artificial intelligence-assisted colonoscopy for colorectal lesion detection: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
papers.authors: Liu X, Qin J, Zhao Y, Zhang C, Wang D, Jiang T
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Colonoscopy is the gold standard for colorectal cancer detection and prevention, but its performance depends on operator skill and lesion features. Artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted colonoscopy has been introduced to improve adenoma detection.
METHODS: A comprehensive search was conducted in PubMed, Embase, the Cochrane Library, Web of Science, ClinicalTrials.gov, and major Chinese databases to identify randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing AI-assisted and conventional colonoscopy. Meta-analyses were performed using Review Manager 5.4 and Stata 14.0. The quality of evidence was graded using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) system, while trial sequential analysis (TSA) was applied to assess the robustness and information sufficiency of the results.
RESULTS: A total of 46 RCTs encompassing 37,012 participants were included. Compared with conventional colonoscopy, AI-assisted colonoscopy was associated with a higher ADR (RR = 1.22, 95% CI = 1.17-1.27, P < 0.00001), polyp detection rate (PDR: RR = 1.22, 95% CI = 1.16-1.29, P < 0.00001), polyp detection per colonoscopy (PPC: MD = 0.28, 95% CI = 0.21-0.36), and adenoma detection per colonoscopy (APC: MD = 0.22, 95% CI = 0.15-0.29). The detection rate of sessile serrated lesions (SSL) was also higher in the AI-assisted group (RR = 1.20, 95% CI: 1.05-1.36, P = 0.007), whereas no significant difference was observed in advanced adenoma detection rate (AADR).
CONCLUSIONS: AI-assisted colonoscopy was associated with improvements in several detection-related quality indicators, including ADR, PDR, PPC, APC, and SSL detection rate. However, given the very low GRADE certainty for ADR and PDR and the lack of long-term outcome data, these findings should be interpreted cautiously.
CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

papers.title_zh: 人工智慧輔助大腸鏡對大腸直腸病灶偵測的效益：隨機對照試驗之系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：大腸鏡是大腸直腸癌偵測與預防的黃金標準，但其表現取決於操作者技術及病灶特徵。人工智慧（AI）輔助大腸鏡已被引入，以提升腺瘤偵測率。
方法：全面搜尋PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library、Web of Science、ClinicalTrials.gov及主要中文資料庫，以找出比較AI輔助與傳統大腸鏡的隨機對照試驗（RCT）。使用Review Manager 5.4及Stata 14.0進行統合分析。採用建議分級、評估、發展與評價（GRADE）系統評定證據品質，並使用試驗序列分析（TSA）評估結果的穩健性與資訊量是否充足。
結果：共納入46項RCT，涵蓋37,012名參與者。與傳統大腸鏡相比，AI輔助大腸鏡與較高的腺瘤偵測率（ADR：RR＝1.22，95% CI＝1.17–1.27，P＜0.00001）、息肉偵測率（PDR：RR＝1.22，95% CI＝1.16–1.29，P＜0.00001）、每次大腸鏡檢查偵測的息肉數（PPC：平均差MD＝0.28，95% CI＝0.21–0.36），以及每次大腸鏡檢查偵測的腺瘤數（APC：MD＝0.22，95% CI＝0.15–0.29）相關。AI輔助組的無蒂鋸齒狀病灶（SSL）偵測率也較高（RR＝1.20，95% CI：1.05–1.36，P＝0.007），但進階腺瘤偵測率（AADR）未觀察到顯著差異。
結論：AI輔助大腸鏡與多項偵測相關品質指標的改善相關，包括ADR、PDR、PPC、APC及SSL偵測率。然而，鑑於ADR與PDR的GRADE證據確定性極低，且缺乏長期結果資料，這些發現應審慎解讀。
臨床試驗編號：不適用。

papers.title: Robotic vs. laparoscopic IPAA in a high-volume referral centre: a retrospective observational study
papers.authors: Galletto G, Violante T, Cardelli S, Calini G, Cuicchi D, Rottoli M
papers.abstract: Ileal pouch-anal anastomosis (IPAA) represents the gold standard in ulcerative colitis patients refractory to medical therapy. While laparoscopy is a well-established alternative to open surgery, further comparative evidence between laparoscopy and robotic approaches is required. This study aims to evaluate intraoperative performance and short-term postoperative outcomes in laparoscopic and robotic IPAA in a high-volume referral centre. This retrospective single-centre study evaluated consecutive patients undergoing minimally invasive proctectomy with IPAA and diverting loop ileostomy between 2017 and 2025 at Sant' Orsola University Hospital, Bologna. Demographic, clinical, surgical, and postoperative data were compared between the laparoscopic and robotic cohorts using a propensity score-matched analysis. This study included 169 patients: 131 in the laparoscopic group and 38 in the robotic one. Demographic characteristics were comparable. The robotic cohort presented a lower conversion rate, though this did not reach statistical significance (13.0% vs. 2.6%, p = 0.078). On the other hand, it presented a faster return to oral diet (p < 0.001). Length of stay, duration of surgery and overall postoperative complications were comparable. The laparoscopic cohort experienced more severe complications (7% Clavien-Dindo ≥ III), while the robotic cohort did not exceed a Grade II. No robotic cases required reoperation at 30 days, compared to 2.3% in the laparoscopic group. Robotic IPAA yielded results comparable to laparoscopy regarding length of stay, duration of surgery and rate of complications. However, the robotic approach showcased a trend towards decreased conversion and 30-day reoperation. It was also associated with decreased complication severity, and faster return to an oral diet, suggesting a potential to expedite and enhance postoperative recovery.

papers.title_zh: 高量轉診中心機器人與腹腔鏡 IPAA 之比較：回溯性觀察研究
papers.abstract_zh: 迴腸儲袋肛門吻合術（IPAA）是藥物治療無效之潰瘍性結腸炎病人的黃金標準治療。腹腔鏡雖已是成熟的開腹手術替代方案，但仍需更多比較腹腔鏡與機器人手術的證據。本研究旨在評估高量轉診中心腹腔鏡與機器人 IPAA 的術中表現及短期術後結果。本單中心回溯性研究評估了2017至2025年間，在波隆那 Sant' Orsola 大學醫院連續接受微創直腸切除、IPAA 及保護性環狀迴腸造口的病人。研究使用傾向分數配對分析，比較腹腔鏡與機器人兩組的人口學、臨床、手術及術後資料。本研究納入169名病人：腹腔鏡組131名，機器人組38名。兩組人口學特徵相當。機器人組的轉開腹率較低，但未達統計顯著差異（腹腔鏡13.0% vs. 機器人2.6%，p＝0.078）。另一方面，機器人組恢復經口飲食較快（p＜0.001）。兩組住院天數、手術時間及整體術後併發症相當。腹腔鏡組出現較嚴重的併發症（7%為 Clavien-Dindo ≥III級），而機器人組的併發症均未超過II級。機器人組無病人在30天內需要再次手術，腹腔鏡組則為2.3%。機器人 IPAA 在住院天數、手術時間及併發症發生率方面，結果與腹腔鏡相當。然而，機器人手術呈現轉開腹及30天再次手術較少的趨勢。此外，機器人手術與較低的併發症嚴重度及較快恢復經口飲食相關，提示其可能加速並改善術後恢復。

papers.title: Mechanisms and functions of the TRIM protein family in digestive system cancers
papers.authors: Xu Y, Jiang Z, Chen X, Yu P
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Tripartite motif-containing (TRIM) proteins are important RING-type E3 ubiquitin ligases that regulate protein fate and signal transduction through ubiquitin/ubiquitin-like modifications and non-ubiquitination mechanisms. In digestive system cancers, TRIM proteins exert highly context-dependent bidirectional effects. Here, we conceptualize TRIM proteins as signal integration nodes linking ubiquitin-mediated regulation, core signaling pathways, and adaptation to the tumor microenvironment.
METHODS: This structured narrative review synthesizes English-language studies indexed in PubMed between January 2010 and October 2025. It focuses on the structural basis, multilevel regulation, molecular networks, phenotypic functions, prognostic relevance, and therapeutic implications of TRIM proteins in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, gastric cancer, colorectal cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma, and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
CONCLUSIONS: The modular architecture of TRIM proteins enables diverse substrate recognition and regulatory outputs. Cross-cancer analysis identifies pathway-convergent, phenotype-convergent, and pathway-phenotype bridging TRIM members that translate dysregulation of core pathways, including Wnt/β-catenin, PI3K/AKT, and p53, into proliferative, cell death-related, metastatic, metabolic, and immune phenotypes. Their functional direction is jointly shaped by tumor type, molecular subtype, substrate status, microenvironmental cues, and treatment context. Selected TRIM members show potential as prognostic biomarkers, risk-stratification indicators, and predictors of therapeutic response, whereas most TRIM-targeted strategies remain preclinical. Future studies should clarify ubiquitin-chain-specific regulatory logic, subtype-specific functions, and multilayered networks, while rigorously evaluating the specificity, safety, and clinical applicability of TRIM-directed combination therapies.
papers.title_zh: TRIM蛋白家族在消化系統癌症中的機制與功能
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：含三重基序（TRIM）蛋白是重要的RING型E3泛素連接酶，透過泛素／類泛素修飾與非泛素化機制，調控蛋白質命運及訊息傳遞。在消化系統癌症中，TRIM蛋白具有高度依賴情境的雙向作用。本文將TRIM蛋白概念化為訊號整合節點，連結泛素介導的調控、核心訊息傳遞路徑，以及對腫瘤微環境的適應。
方法：本篇結構式敘述性綜述整合了2010年1月至2025年10月間收錄於PubMed的英文研究，聚焦於TRIM蛋白在食道鱗狀細胞癌、胃癌、大腸直腸癌、肝細胞癌及胰臟導管腺癌中的結構基礎、多層級調控、分子網絡、表型功能、預後相關性與治療意涵。
結論：TRIM蛋白的模組化結構使其能辨識多樣的受質，並產生不同的調控結果。跨癌種分析辨識出在訊息路徑上匯聚、在表型上匯聚，以及橋接訊息路徑與表型的TRIM成員；這些成員將包括Wnt/β-catenin、PI3K/AKT及p53在內的核心路徑失調，轉化為增殖、細胞死亡相關、轉移、代謝及免疫表型。其功能方向由腫瘤類型、分子亞型、受質狀態、微環境訊號及治療情境共同決定。部分TRIM成員具有作為預後生物標記、風險分層指標及治療反應預測因子的潛力，但多數TRIM標靶策略仍處於臨床前階段。未來研究應釐清泛素鏈特異性的調控邏輯、亞型特異性功能及多層次網絡，同時嚴謹評估TRIM導向合併療法的專一性、安全性及臨床適用性。

papers.title: How food structure and processing govern metabolizable energy: a critical review of the food-matrix determinants of energy availability and the limits of the Atwater accounting
papers.abstract: Food energy is usually reported using Atwater factors: composition-based coefficients that treat metabolizable energy as a function of macronutrient mass rather than food structure. Yet a growing food-science literature shows that metabolizable energy can diverge materially from Atwater predictions according to the integrity of the food matrix and the processing applied to it. This review brings energy-accounting and food-structure science into direct contact. It defines where the Atwater system remains useful and where its structural blind spot becomes consequential; clarifies the frequent conflation of digestibility, bioaccessibility, bioavailability and metabolizable energy, and distinguishes physical resistance from chemical inhibition of digestive enzymes while treating the two as coupled rather than independent. It then maps major processing operations to their structural and energetic consequences, and compares methods used to quantify metabolizable energy and nutrient release, including human balance studies, ileostomy and intubation studies, standardised in vitro digestion, dynamic models and in silico approaches. Tree nuts provide the strongest empirical case. Measured metabolizable energy ranges from about 5% below the Atwater value for pistachios to more than 30% below for whole almonds, a divergence that is explained by matrix integrity and lipid encapsulation. Four energetic consequences of matrix disruption are considered: net metabolizable energy, rate of energy release, thermic effect of feeding and colonic salvage. The review concludes that energy values based on composition alone are insufficient for foods whose structure strongly constrains digestion, and that food-composition data, labelling, feeding research and reformulation would benefit from structure-aware measures of delivered energy.
papers.title_zh: 食物結構與加工如何決定可代謝能：食物基質對能量可利用性的決定因素與 Atwater 能量計算法限制之批判性綜述
papers.abstract_zh: 食物能量通常使用 Atwater 係數表示：這些以組成為基礎的係數，將可代謝能視為巨量營養素質量的函數，而非食物結構的函數。然而，日益增加的食品科學文獻顯示，依食物基質的完整性及其所接受的加工方式而定，可代謝能可能與 Atwater 預測值存在實質差異。本綜述將能量計算與食物結構科學直接連結。本文界定 Atwater 系統在哪些情境下仍然有用，以及其忽略結構的盲點何時會造成重要影響；釐清經常被混為一談的消化率、生物可及性、生物可利用率與可代謝能，並區分物理性阻抗與對消化酵素的化學性抑制，同時將兩者視為相互耦合，而非彼此獨立的作用。接著，本文梳理主要加工操作及其對結構與能量的影響，並比較用於量化可代謝能及營養素釋出的方法，包括人體平衡研究、迴腸造口與腸道插管研究、標準化體外消化、動態模型及電腦模擬方法。樹堅果提供了最有力的實證案例。實測可代謝能與 Atwater 值的差距，從開心果約低 5%，到完整杏仁低逾 30%；此差異可由基質完整性與脂質包埋現象解釋。本文探討基質破壞的四項能量後果：淨可代謝能、能量釋出速率、食物熱效應，以及結腸能量回收。本綜述結論指出，對於結構會強烈限制消化的食物，僅以組成為基礎的能量值並不足夠；食物組成資料、食品標示、餵食研究及配方調整，都可受益於將結構納入考量的實際供應能量測量。

papers.title: Apoptotic cell overload drives multinucleated giant cell formation after neoadjuvant chemotherapy in colorectal cancer: molecular mechanisms and tumor-suppressive effects
papers.authors: Xue J, Wang Z, Zhang X, Xu S, Wu S, Sun X
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer is a common digestive malignancy. Neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) can downstage tumors and increase R0 resection rates. In colorectal cancer specimens with favorable pathological regression after NAC, we observed CD68+ multinucleated giant cells (MGCs) preferentially localized in apoptotic cell-rich areas, whereas they were rarely detected in non-NAC specimens. However, the mechanisms driving MGC formation and their functional significance remain unclear. We established an in vitro apoptotic cell-macrophage co-culture system to assess how apoptotic cell burden and efferocytosis regulate macrophage fusion. The TREM2/TYROBP signaling axis was examined using molecular and pharmacological approaches. RNA sequencing, pathway enrichment, lysosome- and metabolism-related transcriptional analyses, and secretory profiling were performed to characterize efferocytosis-induced MGCs. Their effects on colorectal cancer cells and the tumor microenvironment were further evaluated in vitro and in tumor-bearing mouse models. Excessive apoptotic cell burden markedly promoted macrophage fusion and upregulated the fusion-related molecules DCSTAMP/Dcstamp and CDH1/Cdh1. Apoptotic cell overload shifted macrophages from a homeostatic/efferocytic state toward a fusion-prone MGC phenotype. TYROBP/Tyrobp knockdown or loss inhibited macrophage fusion. Mechanistically, apoptotic cell overload activated the TREM2/TYROBP-MAPK/c-FOS-DCSTAMP axis, thereby enhancing DCSTAMP transcription and macrophage fusion. Efferocytosis-induced MGCs showed reduced lysosome-related transcriptional programs and an altered secretory profile, including increased TNF-α expression. Functionally, MGCs inhibited colorectal cancer cell growth in vitro. In tumor-bearing mice, MGCs reduced CD206⁺ macrophage and regulatory T-cell abundance while increasing CD8+ T-cell infiltration, thereby contributing to tumor growth suppression. Together, these findings identify efferocytosis-induced MGCs as a distinct macrophage state with altered lysosomal and secretory programs, anti-tumor activity, and the potential to remodel the tumor microenvironment.

papers.title_zh: 凋亡細胞過載驅動大腸直腸癌新輔助化療後多核巨細胞形成：分子機制與腫瘤抑制作用
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌是一種常見的消化道惡性腫瘤。新輔助化療（NAC）可使腫瘤降期並提高R0切除率。在NAC後呈現良好病理退縮的大腸直腸癌檢體中，我們觀察到CD68+多核巨細胞（MGCs）優先分布於富含凋亡細胞的區域，而在未接受NAC的檢體中則很少偵測到。然而，驅動MGC形成的機制及其功能意義仍不清楚。我們建立了體外凋亡細胞與巨噬細胞共培養系統，以評估凋亡細胞負荷及凋亡細胞清除作用（efferocytosis）如何調控巨噬細胞融合。研究使用分子與藥理學方法檢視TREM2/TYROBP訊號軸，並進行RNA定序、路徑富集分析、溶酶體與代謝相關轉錄分析，以及分泌物特徵分析，以描繪凋亡細胞清除作用所誘導之MGCs的特性。研究進一步在體外及荷瘤小鼠模型中，評估其對大腸直腸癌細胞與腫瘤微環境的影響。過量的凋亡細胞負荷明顯促進巨噬細胞融合，並上調融合相關分子DCSTAMP/Dcstamp與CDH1/Cdh1。凋亡細胞過載使巨噬細胞由維持恆定／清除凋亡細胞的狀態，轉向傾向融合的MGC表型。TYROBP/Tyrobp基因敲低或缺失會抑制巨噬細胞融合。在機制上，凋亡細胞過載活化TREM2/TYROBP-MAPK/c-FOS-DCSTAMP軸，進而增強DCSTAMP轉錄與巨噬細胞融合。由凋亡細胞清除作用所誘導的MGCs呈現溶酶體相關轉錄程式減弱，以及分泌物特徵改變，包括TNF-α表現增加。在功能上，MGCs可在體外抑制大腸直腸癌細胞生長。在荷瘤小鼠中，MGCs減少CD206+巨噬細胞與調節型T細胞的數量，同時增加CD8+ T細胞浸潤，從而有助於抑制腫瘤生長。整體而言，這些發現指出，由凋亡細胞清除作用所誘導的MGCs是一種獨特的巨噬細胞狀態，具有改變的溶酶體與分泌程式、抗腫瘤活性，以及重塑腫瘤微環境的潛力。

papers.title: LncRNA HITT stabilizes SIRT6 to restrain H3/H4 acetylation and suppress colorectal cancer growth
papers.authors: Li B, Xiang Z, Liu H, Cheng Q, Wang H, Chen K
papers.abstract: Histone post-translational modifications are intimately linked to human diseases, including cancers. While diverse regulatory mechanisms have been described, how long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) control histone acetylation remains incompletely understood. Here, integrative bioinformatics analysis implicates the lncRNA HITT (HIF-1α inhibitor at the translation level) in histone modification-related pathways. Mechanistically, HITT selectively suppresses H3/H4 acetylation in colorectal cancer cells. Using siRNA-based loss-of-function screening and pharmacological inhibition, we identify the sirtuin deacetylase SIRT6 as an essential mediator of this effect. HITT directly binds SIRT6 and increases SIRT6 protein abundance by attenuating its association with the E3 ubiquitin ligase mouse double minute 2 homolog (MDM2), thereby reducing MDM2-dependent ubiquitination and proteasomal turnover of SIRT6. Conversely, the SIRT6 agonist MDL-800 upregulates the transcription factor E2F1, thereby promoting E2F1-dependent transcription of HITT. Functionally, increased HITT expression cooperates with MDL-800 to inhibit colorectal cancer cell proliferation in vitro and suppress tumor growth in vivo. Collectively, these findings define a feed-forward HITT-SIRT6 axis that stabilizes SIRT6 and constrains histone H3/H4 acetylation homeostasis, highlighting a potential combination strategy for colorectal cancer therapy.
papers.title_zh: LncRNA HITT 藉由穩定 SIRT6 限制 H3/H4 乙醯化並抑制大腸直腸癌生長
papers.abstract_zh: 組蛋白轉譯後修飾與人類疾病（包括癌症）密切相關。儘管已有多種調控機制被描述，長鏈非編碼 RNA（lncRNA）如何控制組蛋白乙醯化，仍未完全釐清。本研究透過整合性生物資訊分析，指出 lncRNA HITT（轉譯層級的 HIF-1α 抑制因子）涉及組蛋白修飾相關路徑。在機制上，HITT 會選擇性抑制大腸直腸癌細胞中的 H3/H4 乙醯化。透過以 siRNA 為基礎的功能喪失篩選及藥理抑制，我們確認 sirtuin 去乙醯酶 SIRT6 是此作用不可或缺的媒介。HITT 直接結合 SIRT6，並藉由減弱 SIRT6 與 E3 泛素連接酶小鼠雙微體 2 同源蛋白（MDM2）的結合，增加 SIRT6 蛋白量，進而減少 MDM2 依賴性的 SIRT6 泛素化及蛋白酶體降解。反過來，SIRT6 致效劑 MDL-800 會上調轉錄因子 E2F1，從而促進 E2F1 依賴性的 HITT 轉錄。在功能上，提高 HITT 表現量可與 MDL-800 共同作用，抑制體外大腸直腸癌細胞增殖，並抑制體內腫瘤生長。整體而言，這些發現界定了一條前饋式 HITT–SIRT6 軸，可穩定 SIRT6 並限制組蛋白 H3/H4 乙醯化的恆定調控，凸顯其作為大腸直腸癌潛在合併治療策略的可能性。

papers.title: Dual therapy with tofacitinib and steroids for acute severe ulcerative colitis: a randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial
papers.authors: Arora U, Verma M, Madan D, Singh M, Kandasamy D, Narang H
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: One-third of patients with acute severe ulcerative colitis (ASUC) fail intravenous corticosteroids. We evaluated whether adding tofacitinib to corticosteroids reduces treatment failure in ASUC.
METHODS: In this single-center, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, adults with ASUC were randomized 1:1 to tofacitinib (10 mg three times daily for 3 days, then twice daily) or placebo for 5 days alongside corticosteroids. Primary outcome was treatment failure at day 6 (<3-point Lichtiger reduction or total score ≥10, or colectomy). Secondary outcomes were relapse (≥3-point rise with total ≥10), rescue therapy, and colectomy at 90 days. Modified intention-to-treat analysis was performed. (CTRI/2022/11/047186).
RESULTS: Of 62 randomized patients, 58 were analyzed: 33 in the tofacitinib arm and 25 in the placebo arm. The trial was terminated early because of slow recruitment and did not reach the planned sample size of 98. Day 6 treatment failure was numerically lower with tofacitinib in unadjusted analysis (24.2% vs 36.0%; RR 0.67, 95% CI 0.30-1.51; P = .33) and significantly lower after adjustment for baseline covariate imbalance (adjusted RR 0.47, 95% CI 0.24-0.93; P = .03). At 90 days, colectomy rates were similar (12.1% vs 12.0%; P = 1.0), but more tofacitinib-treated patients remained on assigned therapy (84.4% vs 54.2%) and rescue therapy was lower (HR 0.27, 95% CI 0.09-0.78; P = .01). Serious adverse events occurred in one versus three patients. No deaths occurred with tofacitinib versus two deaths with placebo.
CONCLUSION: Dual therapy with tofacitinib and steroids in ASUC did not significantly reduce treatment failure at day 6, unless adjustment for baseline imbalance in serum albumin was taken into account. It reduced the need for rescue therapy over 90 days without affecting colectomy risk. Larger clinical trials are required to confirm these findings.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：三分之一的急性重症潰瘍性大腸炎（ASUC）病人對靜脈注射類固醇治療失敗。我們評估在類固醇治療中加入 tofacitinib，是否能降低 ASUC 的治療失敗。
方法：這項單中心、雙盲、安慰劑對照試驗，將成人 ASUC 病人以 1:1 隨機分派接受 tofacitinib（前 3 天每次 10 mg、每日三次，之後改為每日兩次）或安慰劑，共治療 5 天，並同時接受類固醇。主要結果為第 6 天治療失敗（Lichtiger 分數下降不足 3 分、總分 ≥10，或接受大腸切除）。次要結果為 90 天內復發（分數上升 ≥3 分且總分 ≥10）、救援治療及大腸切除。採用修正意向治療分析。（試驗註冊編號：CTRI/2022/11/047186）。
結果：62 名隨機分派的病人中，58 名納入分析：tofacitinib 組 33 名，安慰劑組 25 名。試驗因收案緩慢而提前終止，未達原訂的 98 人樣本數。未調整分析中，tofacitinib 組第 6 天治療失敗率在數值上較低（24.2% vs 36.0%；RR 0.67，95% CI 0.30–1.51；P＝0.33）；校正基線共變項不平衡後，則顯著較低（調整後 RR 0.47，95% CI 0.24–0.93；P＝0.03）。90 天時，兩組大腸切除率相近（12.1% vs 12.0%；P＝1.0），但 tofacitinib 組有較多病人持續接受原分派治療（84.4% vs 54.2%），且救援治療需求較低（HR 0.27，95% CI 0.09–0.78；P＝0.01）。嚴重不良事件分別發生於 1 名與 3 名病人。Tofacitinib 組無人死亡，安慰劑組則有 2 人死亡。
結論：在 ASUC 中，tofacitinib 與類固醇雙重療法未能顯著降低第 6 天治療失敗，除非將基線血清白蛋白不平衡納入校正。此療法降低了 90 天內救援治療的需求，但未影響大腸切除風險。仍需更大型臨床試驗確認這些發現。

papers.title: Protective effect of N-acetylcysteine on oxaliplatin-induced peripheral neuropathy in colorectal cancer: a randomized controlled trial
papers.authors: Hegazy Z, Tawfik S, Elmashad N
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Oxaliplatin-induced peripheral neuropathy (OIPN) is a dose-limiting adverse effect of FOLFOX chemotherapy in colorectal cancer (CRC) patients. We aimed to evaluate the protective effect of N-acetylcysteine (NAC) against OIPN. Additionally, we investigated its mechanistic effects on serum biomarkers including total antioxidant capacity (TAC), interleukin-6 (IL-6), and neurotensin.
METHODS: Forty-six patients with stage III or high-risk stage II CRC receiving adjuvant modified FOLFOX-6 chemotherapy were randomized in a 1:1 ratio to receive either oral NAC 1200 mg (effervescent tablets or granules) or placebo one hour before each oxaliplatin infusion for four cycles. Serum levels of TAC, IL-6, and neurotensin were measured before and after treatment. Neuropathy was assessed using the FACT/GOG-NTX-12 and NCI-CTCAE scales, and pain was estimated by using the Brief Pain Inventory-Short Form.
RESULTS: Neurotensin was significantly decreased in the NAC group compared to controls after treatment (P < 0.001), and was significantly lower post-treatment versus pre-treatment in the NAC group (P = 0.001). IL-6 was significantly reduced in the NAC group versus controls after treatment (P < 0.001), and significantly decreased post-treatment in both groups (P < 0.05). FACT/GOG-NTX-12 and NCI-CTCAE scores were significantly lower in the NAC group at the end of the first two cycles and at the end of treatment (P < 0.05). Pain interference, but not pain severity, was significantly reduced in the NAC group at both time points (P < 0.001).
CONCLUSION: NAC administration during FOLFOX chemotherapy significantly reduced OIPN severity, pain interference, and serum levels of IL-6 and neurotensin, suggesting both clinical and mechanistic neuroprotective effects.
CLINICAL REGISTRATION: The study was is registered on ClinicalTrials.gov (ID: NCT07391163).

papers.abstract_zh: 目的：奧沙利鉑誘發周邊神經病變（OIPN）是大腸直腸癌（CRC）患者接受 FOLFOX 化療時的一項劑量限制性不良反應。本研究旨在評估 N-acetylcysteine（NAC）對 OIPN 的保護作用。此外，我們探討其對血清生物標記的機轉性影響，包括總抗氧化能力（TAC）、介白素-6（IL-6）及神經降壓素（neurotensin）。方法：46 名接受術後輔助性 modified FOLFOX-6 化療的第 III 期或高風險第 II 期 CRC 患者，以 1：1 比例隨機分派，於每次奧沙利鉑輸注前一小時口服 NAC 1200 mg（發泡錠或顆粒劑）或安慰劑，共四個療程。於治療前後測量血清 TAC、IL-6 及神經降壓素濃度。神經病變以 FACT/GOG-NTX-12 與 NCI-CTCAE 量表評估，疼痛則以簡明疼痛量表短版（Brief Pain Inventory-Short Form）評估。結果：治療後，NAC 組的神經降壓素較對照組顯著降低（P < 0.001），且 NAC 組治療後較治療前顯著降低（P = 0.001）。治療後，NAC 組的 IL-6 較對照組顯著降低（P < 0.001），且兩組治療後的 IL-6 均顯著下降（P < 0.05）。在前兩個療程結束時及治療結束時，NAC 組的 FACT/GOG-NTX-12 與 NCI-CTCAE 分數均顯著較低（P < 0.05）。在這兩個評估時間點，NAC 組的疼痛干擾程度均顯著減少（P < 0.001），但疼痛強度未顯著減少。結論：在 FOLFOX 化療期間使用 NAC，顯著降低 OIPN 嚴重程度、疼痛干擾程度，以及血清 IL-6 與神經降壓素濃度，提示其具有臨床及機轉層面的神經保護作用。臨床試驗註冊：本研究已於 ClinicalTrials.gov 註冊（編號：NCT07391163）。

papers.title: Biomarkers and future directions for immunotherapy in microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer: a systematic review
papers.authors: Xu J, Ni C, Wang P, Qin L
papers.abstract:
The mechanisms of resistance to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in microsatellite-stable (MSS) colorectal cancer (CRC) have 3 interconnected levels, which provide information to guide different biomarker strategies. There is a critical clinical need, as objective response rates continue to be < 10%. We suggest a biomarker stratification model on the basis of clinical actionability. POLE/POLD1 mutations, recommended by the NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology for Colon Cancer (Version 1.2025), represent true genomic "hard" indicators. While the benefit of ICI-containing combination regimens was predicted by the Immunoscore-IC in the AtezoTRIBE trial, the ANICCA-class II study recently questioned the value of anti-PD-1 monotherapy. Defects in homologous recombination repair HRR), ctDNA kinetics and subtyping of CMS1 show promise but need to be prospectively validated. TMB, however, has shown no consistent value as a single biomarker, and MSIs, such as transcriptomic signatures or PD-L1 combined positive scores, have not been proven to be useful. Future prospects involve multiomics algorithms that integrate immune profiling and stromal determinants, liver-directed sensitizing approaches and serial ctDNA monitoring of acquired resistance as viable strategies for further patient selection. These data collectively pave the way toward moving away from the "cold tumor" paradigm and toward dynamic, host-integrated testing for precision immunotherapy in MSS CRC.
There are three levels of resistance to ICIs in MSS CRC: intrinsic defects, microenvironmental barriers and metastatic immune privilege, and each has different biomarker implications. We suggest a clinically actionable stratification. POLE/POLD1 mutations are genomic “hard” markers per the NCCN. The immunoscore-IC can predict combination but not monotherapy benefits. HRR defects, ctDNA kinetics, and CMS1 subtyping require prospective validation. The TMB, MSI-like signature, and PD-L1 CPS do not have consistent values. Innovations include multiomics integration, liver-targeting sensitization, and ctDNA resistance monitoring. These results suggest that the need for a single marker should be replaced with host-integrated, dynamic approaches for precision immunotherapy.

papers.abstract_zh:
微衛星穩定型（MSS）大腸直腸癌（CRC）對免疫檢查點抑制劑（ICIs）的抗藥機轉具有3個相互關聯的層次，可提供資訊以引導不同的生物標記策略。目前存在迫切的臨床需求，因為客觀反應率持續低於10%。我們依據臨床可行動性，提出一個生物標記分層模型。NCCN《腫瘤臨床實務指引：結腸癌》（第1.2025版）所推薦的POLE/POLD1突變，代表真正的基因體「硬性」指標。雖然Immunoscore-IC在AtezoTRIBE試驗中可預測含ICI之合併療法的效益，但近期ANICCA-class II研究對抗PD-1單藥治療的價值提出質疑。同源重組修復（HRR）缺陷、ctDNA動態變化及CMS1分型展現潛力，但仍需前瞻性驗證。然而，TMB作為單一生物標記並未顯示一致的價值，而MSIs，例如轉錄體特徵或PD-L1綜合陽性分數，也尚未證實具有實用性。未來方向包括整合免疫特徵與間質決定因子的多體學演算法、肝臟導向的增敏策略，以及連續ctDNA監測後天抗藥性，作為進一步篩選病人的可行策略。整體而言，這些資料為擺脫「冷腫瘤」典範、轉向整合宿主因素的動態檢測，以實現MSS CRC精準免疫治療鋪路。

MSS CRC對ICIs的抗藥性有三個層次：內在缺陷、微環境屏障及轉移部位的免疫豁免，各自具有不同的生物標記意涵。我們提出一套具臨床可行動性的分層方式。依據NCCN，POLE/POLD1突變屬於基因體「硬性」標記。Immunoscore-IC可預測合併療法的效益，但無法預測單藥治療的效益。HRR缺陷、ctDNA動態變化及CMS1分型需要前瞻性驗證。TMB、類MSI特徵及PD-L1 CPS並未呈現一致的價值。創新方向包括多體學整合、肝臟標靶增敏及以ctDNA監測抗藥性。這些結果顯示，應以整合宿主因素的動態方法，取代尋求單一標記的需求，以實現精準免疫治療。

papers.title: Analysing the implementation and transferability of an enhanced care pathway integrating systematic supportive cancer care and patient-partner support for people living with anal cancer: Protocol for a mixed-methods study in two French cancer centres
papers.authors: Carillon S, Faure R, Del Rio M, Lemanski C, Tyran M, de Montgolfier S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Supportive cancer care (SCC) is essential for comprehensive oncology care. It addresses treatment-related adverse effects, reduces long-term sequelae and improves patients' quality of life. Patient-partner (PP) programmes positively impact psychological well-being, patient empowerment and supportive care. Nevertheless, access to SCC remains inconsistent, fragmented and unequally distributed, while PPs are rarely integrated into routine cancer care pathways. Anal cancer is a predominantly localised cancer with high survival rates. Treatment is associated with acute toxicity and often severe long-term sequelae. This interventional public health research study aims to implement and evaluate an innovative enhanced care pathway combining systematic SCC and structured PP support for all individuals diagnosed with anal cancer living in France. The study will assess the intervention's clinical, organisational, and social effects, and will identify the conditions required for its long-term sustainability and transferability.
METHODS AND DESIGN: This is a longitudinal mixed-methods case study conducted in two French Comprehensive Cancer Centres. The intervention entails introducing a systematic, coordinated, and repeated SCC offer together with a structured PP support programme for all patients diagnosed with anal cancer and over 12 months following diagnosis. One centre will implement the enhanced care pathway, while the other will initially provide standard care before progressively adopting the intervention during the transferability phase. Quantitative data will include patient-reported outcomes, clinical information and implementation indicators. Qualitative data exploring implementation processes, organisational changes and contextual determinants, will be collected through observations, semi-structured interviews, focus groups and PP activity logs.
DISCUSSION: The study's results will provide essential scientific knowledge on the implementation of programmes providing equitable SCC and PP support access to people living with anal cancer. Specifically, by combining implementation research, participatory approaches and mixed-methods evaluation, the project aims to identify the organisational conditions for the sustainable implementation of such programmes for this population, and their successful transferability to other populations living with cancer and to other healthcare settings.

papers.title_zh: 分析整合系統性癌症支持性照護與病人夥伴支持之強化照護路徑的執行與可轉移性：於法國兩家癌症中心進行的混合方法研究計畫
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：癌症支持性照護（SCC）是完整腫瘤照護不可或缺的一環。其處理治療相關不良反應、減少長期後遺症，並改善病人的生活品質。病人夥伴（PP）方案對心理福祉、病人賦權及支持性照護具有正面影響。然而，SCC的可近性仍不一致、零碎且分布不均，而PP也很少被納入常規癌症照護路徑。肛門癌多為局限性癌症，且存活率高。其治療伴隨急性毒性，以及往往相當嚴重的長期後遺症。本介入性公共衛生研究旨在為所有居住於法國且確診肛門癌者，導入並評估一項結合系統性SCC與結構化PP支持的創新強化照護路徑。本研究將評估此介入的臨床、組織與社會層面影響，並辨識其長期持續運作與轉移應用所需的條件。
方法與設計：本研究是在法國兩家綜合癌症中心進行的縱向混合方法個案研究。介入內容為向所有確診肛門癌的病人，在診斷後12個月期間提供系統性、協調且重複提供的SCC服務，以及結構化PP支持方案。一家中心將導入強化照護路徑，另一家則先提供標準照護，再於可轉移性階段逐步採用此介入。量化資料將包括病人自陳結果、臨床資訊及執行指標。用於探索執行過程、組織變化及情境決定因素的質性資料，將透過觀察、半結構式訪談、焦點團體及PP活動紀錄蒐集。
討論：本研究結果將提供重要科學知識，說明如何執行可讓肛門癌病人公平取得SCC及PP支持的方案。具體而言，本計畫結合執行研究、參與式取徑及混合方法評估，旨在辨識此類方案於該族群持續執行所需的組織條件，以及成功轉移應用至其他癌症族群與其他醫療照護場域所需的條件。

papers.title: Engineering extracellular vesicles for inflammatory bowel disease and colitis-associated colorectal cancer: from therapeutic innovation to clinical translation
papers.authors: Huang M, Yuan J, Muro P, Jin T, Mao F, Zhu W
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), encompassing Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, is a chronic relapsing inflammatory disorder that increases the risk of colitis-associated colorectal cancer (CAC). Despite major advances in biologics and small-molecule therapies, many patients experience primary or secondary treatment failure, adverse effects, and disease recurrence, underscoring the need for more effective, targeted therapeutic strategies. Extracellular vesicles (EVs), including exosomes, microvesicles, and apoptotic bodies, have emerged as promising nanoscale therapeutic platforms owing to their intrinsic biocompatibility, low immunogenicity, cargo-protective lipid bilayer, and natural ability to mediate intercellular communication. Recent advances in EV engineering have further expanded their therapeutic potential through genetic modification of parental cells, cargo loading, surface functionalization, and hybrid biomaterial systems, enabling enhanced targeting, drug delivery, immune modulation, tissue regeneration, and anti-tumor activity. This review summarizes the biological characteristics of EVs and discusses recent progress in engineering strategies aimed at improving their therapeutic efficacy in IBD and CAC. We critically evaluate current preclinical evidence regarding immunomodulation, restoration of intestinal barrier integrity, regulation of gut microbiota, targeted drug delivery, cancer immunotherapy, and inhibition of metastasis. Finally, we discuss the major translational challenges, including manufacturing standardization, quality control, large-scale production, safety evaluation, regulatory considerations, and future perspectives necessary for successful clinical implementation of engineered EV-based therapies.

papers.title_zh: 工程化細胞外囊泡用於發炎性腸道疾病與結腸炎相關大腸直腸癌：從治療創新到臨床轉譯
papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）包括克隆氏症與潰瘍性結腸炎，是一種慢性、反覆發作的發炎性疾病，會增加結腸炎相關大腸直腸癌（CAC）的風險。儘管生物製劑與小分子治療已有重大進展，許多病人仍面臨原發性或次發性治療失敗、不良反應及疾病復發，凸顯出對更有效且具標靶性的治療策略之需求。細胞外囊泡（EVs）包括外泌體、微囊泡與凋亡小體，因其固有的生物相容性、低免疫原性、可保護所載物質的脂質雙層，以及介導細胞間通訊的天然能力，已成為備受期待的奈米尺度治療平台。近期EV工程技術的進展，透過來源細胞的基因改造、載荷裝載、表面功能化及混合式生物材料系統，進一步擴展其治療潛力，使其能增強標靶定位、藥物遞送、免疫調節、組織再生與抗腫瘤活性。本綜述整理EV的生物學特性，並討論旨在提升其於IBD與CAC治療效能的工程策略之最新進展。我們批判性評估目前有關免疫調節、腸道屏障完整性恢復、腸道菌相調控、標靶藥物遞送、癌症免疫治療及抑制轉移的臨床前證據。最後，我們討論成功將工程化EV療法導入臨床所需面對的主要轉譯挑戰，包括製造標準化、品質管制、大規模生產、安全性評估、法規考量與未來展望。

papers.title: Gut mycobiome dysbiosis in digestive system cancers: immune remodeling and translational implications
papers.journal_full: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
papers.authors: Ma L, Wang Z, Mao J
papers.abstract: Fungal dysbiosis has been reported in colorectal cancer (CRC), gastric cancer (GC), and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), but evidence strength differs substantially by tumor type and model system. Human CRC studies provide the broadest ecological evidence, including altered fungal community structure and fungal-bacterial networks. Human GC evidence is mainly cross-sectional and identifies Candida albicans as a candidate tissue-associated signal rather than a proven driver. In PDAC, human tissue studies report fungal signals, whereas causal support for Malassezia-mannose-binding lectin (MBL)-complement and fungal IL-33/type 2 immunity derives principally from mouse perturbation models. This narrative review synthesizes cancer-specific observations, fungal sensing, epithelial injury, immune remodeling, cross-kingdom interactions, and translational implications. We emphasize that low fungal biomass, contamination, transient dietary or environmental fungi, non-standardized sequencing, spatial uncertainty, and reverse causation limit interpretation. Fungal detection does not establish viability, colonization, or tumor causation. Clinical translation will require standardized controls, absolute fungal-load measurements, spatial confirmation, longitudinal cohorts, functional validation, and external testing of whether fungal features add value beyond established clinical, bacterial, metabolic, imaging, and immune markers.
papers.title_zh: 消化系統癌症中的腸道真菌相失衡：免疫重塑與轉譯意涵
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）、胃癌（GC）及胰臟導管腺癌（PDAC）均已有真菌相失衡的報告，但證據強度因腫瘤類型與模型系統而有顯著差異。人類 CRC 研究提供了最廣泛的生態學證據，包括真菌群落結構及真菌—細菌網絡的改變。人類 GC 的證據主要來自橫斷面研究，將白色念珠菌辨識為與組織相關的候選訊號，而非已獲證實的致病驅動因子。在 PDAC 中，人類組織研究曾報告真菌訊號；然而，支持馬拉色菌—甘露糖結合凝集素（MBL）—補體，以及真菌相關 IL-33／第 2 型免疫之因果關係的證據，主要來自小鼠擾動實驗模型。本敘述性綜述整合了各癌別的觀察結果、真菌感知、上皮損傷、免疫重塑、跨界交互作用及轉譯意涵。我們強調，真菌生物量低、污染、短暫存在的飲食或環境來源真菌、未標準化的定序方法、空間定位的不確定性，以及反向因果關係，均限制了結果的解讀。偵測到真菌並不代表已證實其具有活性、形成定殖，或造成腫瘤。臨床轉譯將需要標準化的對照措施、真菌絕對負荷量測、空間定位確認、縱向世代研究、功能驗證，以及外部驗證，以確認真菌特徵是否能在既有的臨床、細菌、代謝、影像及免疫標記之外提供額外價值。

papers.title: Polidocanol foam sclerotherapy for patients with Goligher grade IV hemorrhoidal disease unwilling to undergo surgery: preliminary outcomes from a retrospective study with 6-month follow-up
papers.authors: Gravante G, De Simone V, Picciariello A, Sorge R, Sileri P, Gallo G
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Polidocanol foam (PF) sclerotherapy has shown promising results in low- and intermediate-grade hemorrhoidal disease (HD), but evidence in advanced stages remains limited. This study aimed to evaluate patient-reported outcomes following PF sclerotherapy in patients with Goligher grade IV HD who declined surgical treatment.
METHODS: This retrospective analysis included patients with Goligher grade IV HD that declined hemorrhoidectomy after appropriate counseling and underwent 3% PF sclerotherapy between June and October 2025. Outcomes were assessed using symptom-focused subsets derived from the PROM-HISS and HDSS instruments at baseline, 7 days, 30 days, and 6 months. Primary outcome was the change in scores over time. Secondary outcomes included need for additional treatment, complications, and subsequent surgery.
RESULTS: Fifteen patients were included (mean age 58 ± 11 years; 53.3% male). At 6 months, 66.7% of patients requested no further hemorrhoidal treatment. Significant improvements were observed in both scores across all follow-up timepoints (p < 0.05). Pain, bleeding, and prolapse showed the most consistent reductions. One patient (6.7%) required hemorrhoidectomy within 30 days, four patients (26.7%) a second sclerotherapy session. No major complications were observed.
CONCLUSIONS: In selected patients with Goligher grade IV HD who are unwilling or unfit to undergo surgery, PF sclerotherapy may be associated with short-term symptom improvement and may represent a symptom-oriented minimally invasive option for selected patients unwilling or unfit to undergo surgery.

papers.title_zh: Polidocanol泡沫硬化治療用於不願接受手術的Goligher第IV級痔瘡患者：一項追蹤6個月之回溯性研究的初步結果
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：Polidocanol泡沫（PF）硬化治療在低度與中度痔瘡疾病（HD）已展現令人期待的結果，但晚期疾病的證據仍有限。本研究旨在評估拒絕手術治療之Goligher第IV級HD患者接受PF硬化治療後的病人自陳結果。
方法：本回溯性分析納入經適當諮詢後拒絕痔瘡切除術，並於2025年6月至10月接受3% PF硬化治療的Goligher第IV級HD患者。於基線、7天、30天及6個月，使用取自PROM-HISS與HDSS量表、聚焦症狀的題目子集評估結果。主要結果為評分隨時間的變化。次要結果包括追加治療需求、併發症及後續手術。
結果：共納入15名患者（平均年齡58 ± 11歲；男性占53.3%）。至6個月時，66.7%的患者未要求進一步痔瘡治療。兩項評分在所有追蹤時間點均顯著改善（p < 0.05）。疼痛、出血與脫垂的減輕最為一致。1名患者（6.7%）在30天內需要接受痔瘡切除術，4名患者（26.7%）需要第二次硬化治療。未觀察到重大併發症。
結論：對於經篩選、不願或不適合接受手術的Goligher第IV級HD患者，PF硬化治療可能與短期症狀改善相關，並可能成為這類經篩選、不願或不適合接受手術患者的一種以症狀改善為導向的微創選項。
